CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: Packet page 4 is unreadable, and this build made it so. The page is Nebraska form DC 1:15, whose caption block is a set of alternate captions the form's own script shows one at a time. In the delivered packet all of them are printed on top of each other: "IN RE NAME CHANGE OF", "IN THE MATTER OF THE ADOPTION OF:", "IN RE EMANCIPATION OF:", "IN THE MATTER OF THE ESTATE OF:" and the Plaintiff/Petitioner caption are superimposed in one block, together with "Petitioner. / Decedent. / A Minor child. / Minor Child(ren) / Defendant/Respondent." and the red box the form itself says "The items in this box will NOT print on your form." Measured geometrically: 47 same-baseline text-on-text overlaps in each fixture, up to 91pt wide, all on page 4. Traced to its cause rather than asserted: the corpus source DC-1-15 was measured the same way in this lane and carries 0 text-on-text overlaps across its two pages, and its rendered page reads as a single clean caption. The defect is introduced by the build's flattening of hidden widget appearances, not inherited from the source. Separately, ten underscore rules run past the right page edge (x1 = 613 on a 612pt page) on packet pages 4 and 5, where the source has one. The family holds a RASTER_PASS receipt; the raster gate proves the pages render, not that they can be read.

evidence.method: pdftotext -bbox word geometry per page, plus a visual read of the committed raster pages 4 and 5 and of the corpus source rendered in this lane

FILING_DESTINATION.finding: The packet does not say where it is filed. participant-instructions.md is a list of blank field identifiers with no filing section of any kind; the packet's own pages carry the caption "IN THE ______ COURT OF ______ COUNTY, NEBRASKA" with both blanks empty, so not even a court type is fixed on the face. Amendment A1's test is answered yes: the committed track registry holds "Clerk of the sentencing court ... filed in the existing criminal case, in person, by mail, or by fax for a self-represented filer. In district court the participant obtains a hearing date from the judge's bailiff and then files DC 1:15 and gives a copy to the prosecutor; in county court the clerk schedules and mails notice." The repository establishes the destination and the packet is silent about it.

evidence.captionBlanksOnTheFace: IN THE ______ COURT OF ______ COUNTY, NEBRASKA, both blanks empty in both fixtures

FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: Silence. Searched in this lane across the full extracted text of both fixtures and the whole of participant-instructions.md: no amount, no statement that filing is free, no waiver or in-forma-pauperis procedure, and no office named to ask. That is the standard's first not-met clause exactly — a participant cannot tell from this packet whether filing is free, whether a fee exists, or whom to ask.

SERVICE.finding: The packet names no recipient, no method and no authority to ask. participant-instructions.md says only that "a certificate of mailing is completed after mailing has happened" — a timing rule, not a service rule. The DC 1:15 certificate of service page carries blank "Name" and "Address" rules with no recipient identified, and the caption block that would identify the proceeding is the illegible one. The committed track registry holds the rule: the participant obtains a hearing date from the judge's bailiff, files DC 1:15 and gives a copy to the prosecutor in district court, while in county court the clerk schedules and mails notice. The repository establishes it, the packet does not state it, and no named checkable authority stands in its place.

evidence.whatTheInstructionsSayAboutService: a certificate of mailing is completed after mailing has happened
evidence.trackRegistryService: district court: bailiff sets the hearing, participant files DC 1:15 and gives a copy to the prosecutor; county court: the clerk schedules and mails notice

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: Met on the narrow reading and no more. The instructions state which facts the platform will not supply — "The platform does not hold the value, and it is not guessed: a guessed arresting agency is worse than a blank one, because the blank is visible and the guess is not" — and which fields it will not sign: "Signature, signature date, and any certificate of mailing are deliberately left blank and are not listed here: you sign them." There is no statement that the artifact carries no approval and no not-legal-advice paragraph; the control plane carries that instead — approval-request.json records status REQUESTED, generationAllowed false, runtimeSelectable false, independentVisualReviewRequired true, outputLegalApprovalRequired true, zero commercial routes opened.

rows.whyNotAPass: Four of fifteen obligations fail, and one of them is a page a participant cannot read. The prior verdict on this family came from an older codex-cloud lane scoring a narrower obligation set; the geometry, the corpus comparison and the three participant-facing questions were not among what it scored. The repair has two independent parts: stop the build flattening DC 1:15's hidden alternate-caption appearances into visible content, and give the family real filing, fee and service sections in place of a dump of PDF field identifiers.

baseShaNotDeclaredAtDocumentLevel.why: This document is mixed: the FABLE-VT2 rows carry their own verifiedAtBase; the older rows in the same array were read by VF-SRC-A at a commit FABLE-VT2 cannot state. standardApplied.FEE_AND_WAIVER: DET-FEE-AND-WAIVER-001. Met by a sourced amount, by a sourced statement that no fee is charged, or by stating that no held source establishes the fee AND naming a specific reachable authority. Silence fails.
standardApplied.FILING_DESTINATION: DET-FEE-AND-WAIVER-001 amendment A1. Ask first whether the repository establishes the answer; where the committed track registry holds the destination, the packet must state it, and a named authority does not stand in. A prefilled caption identifying a court type is evidence but is not the instructions naming a destination.
standardApplied.SERVICE: The determination's extension: met when the packet states who must be served and how, or states affirmatively that the participant serves nobody with the mechanism that replaces it, or names a reachable authority for a rule no held source establishes. Silence fails.
standardApplied.SELF_HELP_STOP: Met when the packet states where the platform stops: which facts it will not supply, which fields it will not sign, and that the artifact carries no approval.

vt6Read.grantsNothing: A verdict moves a family in the queue. It promotes nothing, opens no route, and prepares no review package.
